definition: silver (Ag.).
example_en: She had worn bangles made of silver.

definition: a brother of one's mother; a maternal uncle.
example_en: My maternal uncle lives in Mumbai.

definition: greatness; nobility; dignity.
example_en: That king's dignity was known to everyone.

definition: (gen.) a blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: The child brought a flower from the garden.

definition: a place or building where examinations are held for students.
example_en: The students reached the examination centre early.

definition: to raise a pandal.
example_en: They raised a pandal in front of the temple for the festival.

definition: to building, construct something over a relatively wide area.
example_en: The people built a tent over a wide area in the field.

definition: a woman; a lady (a polite term of address).
example_en: Madam, please sit down here.

definition: to come or go near; to approach.
example: ಅವನು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ನನ್ನ ಬಳಿ ಸಾರಿ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He slowly approached and came near me.

definition: to be excited from excessive joy.
example_en: On hearing the result, she got excited with sheer joy.

definition: the inner apartment or apartments of a house.
example_en: She sat silently in the inner apartment of the house.

definition: the act or process of raising the height (of).
example_en: The workers laboured to raise the height of the wall.

definition: a future event.
example_en: No one knows what the future event will be.

definition: a being having the physical body.
example_en: Death is certain for a being that has a physical body.

definition: to make a circle around; enclose within a circle; to surround; to encircle.
example_en: The soldiers surrounded the fort.

definition: the act of praising, extolling or flattering.
example_en: The people's praise was given for her honesty.

definition: to divide into parts or separate a portion from a whole.
example_en: The teacher divided the students into groups.

definition: an erstwhile silver coin equal to one eighth of a rupee.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಚವಲ ಎಂಟನೇ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಸಮನಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times one chavala equalled one eighth of a rupee.

definition: a tape with which something is officially bound and sealed.
example_en: They tied and sealed the parcel with a sealing tape.

definition: the powder of sandalwood.
example_en: She applied sandalwood powder to her forehead.

definition: amounting to two times.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿಯ ಫಸಲು ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಇಪ್ಪಾಲು ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year's harvest is twice as much as last year's.

definition: one undertaking a profession not naturally suited to him.
example: ಅವನು ಬಡಗಿತನ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಅಡ್ಡಕಸಬಿಯಾಗಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He left carpentry and does trading, a profession not suited to him.

definition: a container made of interwoven bamboo splits, strips of wood, cane, etc., usu. without a handle; a basket.
example_en: The grandmother filled the basket with fruits.

definition: an offensive or ceremonial defilement.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಡಿಮೈಲಿಗೆ ಆಚರಿಸಿದ ನಂತರವೇ ಮದುವೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The marriage took place only after the ceremonial defilement was observed in the village.

definition: a kind of large, black ant.
example_en: The large black ant had built a nest at the foot of the tree.

definition: a most talented and fierce archer.
example_en: That warrior was called a most talented and fierce archer.

definition: (mus.) a particular basic measure of rhythm in music.
example: ಈ ಹಾಡಿನ ದೇಶಾದಿ ತಾಳವನ್ನು ಗುರುಗಳು ಕಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher taught the dēśādi rhythm of this song.

definition: a veil used (by women) to cover the face.
example: ಆ ಹೆಂಗಸು ಮೊಗವಡ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: That woman covered her face with a veil and went to the market.

definition: (pl.) the five divisions of a whole.
example: ಆ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಅಯ್ತಂಡಗಳಾಗಿ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: According to that treatise, the world is divided into five parts.

definition: to cultivate (land); to farm.
example_en: The people of that region cultivate paddy.

definition: a kind of worm .
example: ಒದ್ದೆ ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬುೞು ಎಂಬ ಹುಳು ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: A kind of worm called tumbulu appeared in the wet soil.

definition: a disease in which fistulas and ulcerous holes form in the private parts.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ನೂತಿ ರೋಗ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ವೈದ್ಯರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said that patient had the fistulous disease.

definition: the act of abusing, blaming; abuse; blame.
example: ಆ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಿಯ್ಯಾಳಿಕೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: In that meeting, he was blamed and abused.

definition: imperfectly joined; faultily coordinated.
example_en: That account appeared imperfectly coordinated.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example_en: The grandfather arranged the fruits on the bamboo plate.

definition: small pieces, as of metal, scraped off with a file; filings.
example: ಕಮ್ಮಾರನು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣವನ್ನು ಉಜ್ಜಿ ಅರಹುಡಿಯನ್ನು ಪಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿದನು.
example_en: The blacksmith rubbed the iron and filled a vessel with the filings.

definition: an instance of acting in a dictatorial manner; arrogant, domineering or unduly proud behaviour.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಕುಬ್ಬಾಟ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His domineering behaviour at the meeting irritated everyone.

definition: a string of gold or silver for wearing round the neck; a necklace.
example_en: Her necklace was made of silver.

definition: that which has a hole bored in the septum of the nose; an ox or any other draught animal.
example_en: The farmer used the nose-pierced draught ox to plough the field.

definition: the art of writing beautifully; calligraphy.
example_en: He learned the art of writing beautifully at school.

definition: a helper; an attendant.
example_en: They appointed a helper for the household work.

definition: an archaic, copper coin of very low denomination.
example_en: The shopkeeper returned small change coins as balance.

definition: a large, rectangular piece of cotton, linen, silk, etc., used on a bed or as a wrapper over the body; a sheet; bedspread.
example: ಅವಳು ಹೊಸ ಚಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ಮಂಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಾಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She spread a new sheet on the cot.

definition: a despicable, detestable person.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಿದ ಆ ಹೀನಾಳಿಯನ್ನು ಯಾರೂ ನಂಬಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Nobody believed that despicable liar.

definition: a kind of bamboo plant; .
example_en: This kind of bamboo has grown thickly in that forest.

definition: to become full; to be completely filled with.
example_en: The lake becomes completely full during the rainy season.

definition: any of the pieces of hard tissue that make up the skeleton of a vertebrate animal, and consist largely of calcium phosphate or carbonate in a matrix of collagen fibres; a bone.
example_en: He broke his bone falling while playing.

definition: an eye affected by the disease characterised by a white opaque layer developed on the eye.
example: ಆತನ ಒಂದು ಕಣ್ಣು ಬುದ್ಬುದನೇತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳಕು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: One of his eyes had become clouded with an opaque film and could not see light.

definition: a seat for a rider on a horse, usu. padded and of leather.
example: ಕುದುರೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ತಡಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಸವಾರ ಏರಿದನು.
example_en: The rider fastened the saddle on the horse and mounted it.

definition: a tall basket used as a corn-storing bin.
example_en: The farmers stored the crop in the tall corn-basket.

definition: not complete; half-done; unfinished; incomplete; not thorough.
example: ಅರಕಳಿ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮೊದಲು ಅದನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸು.
example_en: Leave the half-done work and first complete it.

definition: to gather or scrape together with or as with a rake, spade or fingers.
example_en: She raked out the ashes with her hand.

definition: to be scratched by finger nail or nails.
example_en: While playing, his hand got scratched by nails.

definition: a wooden spoon or ladle.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಳೆಯ ದಾರುಹಸ್ತ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇದೆ.
example_en: An old wooden spoon still exists in grandmother's house.

definition: to make an inroad; to take or assume (power, a position, property, rights, etc.) and hold in possession by force or without right; to usurp; to encroach upon.
example_en: The enemies seized the kingdom by force.

definition: the sharp, short sound made by snapping a finger with the thumb.
example_en: He started singing while snapping his fingers with a chutige sound.

definition: the act or function of supervising; superintendence; supervision.
example_en: The supervision of this project has been entrusted to him.

definition: (astrol.) the matching of the horoscopes of a man and woman for purpose of marrying them to each other.
example_en: Before the wedding, they had the horoscopes matched.

definition: a pair of metal cymbals.
example_en: The cymbals were played during the devotional singing.

definition: a female companion, associate; a friend.
example: ಅವಳ ಸಂಗಿನಿ ಅವಳ ಜೊತೆ ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದಳು.
example_en: Her female companion walked with her in the market.

definition: a projection from a fortification; a bastion.
example_en: The enemies came and stood near the bastion.

definition: to be a receptacle, resort for something.
example_en: This box serves as a receptacle for all the things.

definition: the act of sinking; immersing.
example_en: The sinking of the boat happened slowly.

definition: to cease or fail to remember; to be unable to recall;
example_en: I forgot his name.

definition: a tall spar or, now often, a hollow metal structure, sometimes in sections, rising vertically from the keel or deck of a vessel and used to support the sails, yards, radar and radio equipment, etc.; the mast of a vessel.
example_en: The sail was tied to the ship's mast.

definition: the act, process or fact of pushing, driving out; ejection.
example_en: The committee passed a resolution for his expulsion.

definition: to agree willingly to; to consent.
example_en: He willingly consented to the marriage.

definition: the act or course of digging; the act of loosening the soil.
example_en: The workers came for the digging of the well.

definition: darkness; complete absence of daylight.
example_en: The path could not be seen in the darkness of the forest.

definition: the quality of being sharp or keen.
example: ಆ ಕತ್ತಿಯ ಮಸೆತ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed to see the sharpness of that knife.

definition: an interjection used in praising a performer; well done!; bravo!.
example: ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರು ಗಾಯಕನಿಗೆ ಬಾಪು ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: The audience shouted 'bravo' in praise of the singer.

definition: an ornament of glass (as a bangle).
example_en: The glass bangle on her hand was shining.

definition: to mistake something for an earthworm.
example_en: He mistook the worm for an earthworm and caught the wrong one.

definition: one (a single) direction.
example_en: They walked away in a single direction.

definition: a large stone worn smooth by erosion.
example_en: A large stone worn smooth lay on the riverbank.

definition: a decorated figures made of flowers.
example_en: A flower design had been arranged in front of the temple.

definition: a hollow place in the stem or a branch of a tree.
example_en: A beehive had formed in the hollow of the tree trunk.

definition: to cook (food).
example_en: Mother cooked the rice in the kitchen.

definition: a kind of grass:.
example_en: Miriḷe grass had grown along the field bund.

definition: the process of perceiving, knowing and, understanding.
example_en: Reading is necessary for the acquisition of knowledge.

definition: a royal road; a highway.

definition: the palms of the hands joined together, as in respectful salutation or greeting.

definition: a kind of grass ( = sīte).
example_en: Manuve grass had grown at the edge of the field.

definition: to grasp; to hold; to seize.
example_en: He grasped the rope firmly.

definition: the door or doorframe of the main entrance.
example_en: The main entrance doorframe of the house was made of old wood.

definition: general talk not based on definite knowledge; gossip; hearsay.
example_en: That news remained only as mere street gossip.

definition: an unfaithful, trecherous, perfidious policy, scheme.
example_en: The organization suffered a great loss because of his treacherous policy.

definition: to obstruct; to object; to impede; to encumber.
example_en: His friends objected to his bad plan.

definition: the quality of being lusterous; lustre; brilliance.
example_en: The brilliance of the gold was visible from afar.

definition: a man who is dependent on another for his livelihood.
example: ಆ ಉಪಜೀವಕ ತನ್ನ ಸೋದರನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.

definition: a bird that is caged.
example_en: That caged bird longed for freedom.

definition: being uncomfortable; causing illness.
example: ಈ ಆಹಾರ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅಹಿತ ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯರು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor said this food is unwholesome for health.

definition: the woody extension growing from the trunk of a tree; a branch.
example_en: The tree's branch broke and fell in the wind.

definition: a kind of insect.

definition: Śiva, who has a destructive, fiery eye on his forehead.
example_en: The devotees offered flowers to Shiva, the one with the fiery eye.

definition: a place where tents, huts, barracks or other more or less temporary structures have been put up for soldiers; a camp.
example_en: The army established the camp on the river bank.

definition: the quality or condition of being intense, vehement or impetuous.
example_en: Intensity and vehemence were clearly evident in his words.

definition: the act of blowing; expanding (as of a flower).
example_en: The flower's blooming happened in the morning sunlight.

definition: the ninth lunar mansion.
example_en: The astrologer explained the effects of the ninth lunar mansion.

definition: the tree Feronia limonia ( = F. elephantum) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: They sat in the shade of the wood apple tree.

definition: one's daughter.
example_en: His daughter is very clever in studies.

definition: (arch.) a kind of tax levied on water (based on the quantity used).
example_en: The villagers used to pay the water tax.

definition: the plant Polianthes tuberosa of Agavaceae famiy.
example_en: They use the tuberose flower for the worship of God.

definition: the food served for eating or eaten.
example_en: They served food to the devotees at the temple.

definition: excessive grief.
example_en: The family fell into excessive grief on hearing news of the accident.

definition: to cause to enter into; to make something go in.
example_en: He made the clothes go inside the bag.

definition: to fear; to be afraid (of).

definition: the act of going out; an instance of this; exit; departure.

example_en: The mad dog ran hither and thither in the street.

definition: to add spice or season with spice.
example_en: The cook added spice to the curry.

definition: not artificial, fraudulent, illusory, false or apparent; real; true.
example_en: His words are true; there is no falsehood in them.

definition: that which is written by hand.
example_en: This hand-written document is in his own handwriting.

definition: a strong desire; yearning; longing.
example_en: There was a longing for wealth in his mind.

definition: the bird Ardea sibirica of Ardeidae family.
example_en: A gonarda bird was seen on the lake's bank.

definition: a resin that is hard.
example_en: The hard resin of that tree was very solid.

definition: a trying to attract the attention and admiration of men for mere self-gratification; a flirting.
example_en: Her flirting attracted everyone's attention.

definition: the coldest season of the year; winter.
example_en: As soon as winter came, the hills got covered with mist.

definition: a false accusation.
example_en: They put a false accusation on him.

definition: to become knotty or more knotty.
example_en: The rope became more and more knotty.

definition: name of a country.
example_en: Kaikeyi is the princess of the country Kekaya.

definition: to throw here and there or strew loosely; to scatter.
example: ಬಿರುಗಾಳಿ ಒಣ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಗಿಬ್ಬಿ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The strong wind scattered the dry leaves everywhere.

definition: that which is harsh, hard, strict or stern.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ಗನ್ನನಿಟ್ಟುರ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That officer's harshness instilled fear in everyone.

definition: blood, as a red liquid.
example_en: Blood flowed on the battlefield.

definition: of more than normal height or stature; tall; high.
example: ಗುಡ್ಡದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಮರ ಉಂಚ ಎತ್ತರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The tree atop the hill had grown very tall.

definition: a thing to sleep on; a bed; a mattress.
example_en: He slept on the mattress.

definition: a deceitful act of speech.
example_en: Deceitful speech was clearly evident in his words.

definition: the frame of a door; a door-frame.
example_en: The carpenter fitted a new door-frame to the door.

definition: an advising with evil or wicked ideas.
example: ಆ ಮಂತ್ರಿಯ ಶಿಖಾವಟ್ಟು ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಡು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That minister's wicked counsel brought ruin to the kingdom.

definition: grown; progressed; developed.
example_en: The company's business grew and developed.

definition: to miss one's path, course of action; to go astray.
example_en: During the night journey they went astray from their path.

definition: to be satiated, satisfied.
example_en: After drinking water, she was satisfied.

definition: the coldest season of the year; winter.
example: ನೀಹಾರಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ದಟ್ಟ ಮಂಜು ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In the misty winter season, there is dense fog early in the morning.

definition: intensity, the quality or state of being a) vigorous, directed sharply to a single point, area or subject; b) producing intensity; c) giving force or emphasis, 2) that which causes mental pain as anger, anxiety, excitement, etc.
example_en: Intensity was clearly visible in his words.

definition: an unclean, dirty man.
example: ಆ ಕೊೞಕ ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡದೆ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಲೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That dirty man wandered the street without bathing.

definition: excessive or comparatively more heat.
example_en: The heat is excessive this summer.

definition: the work, profession of a commission agent or broker.
example: ಈ ಪೇಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಳ್ಳಾಳತನದಿಂದ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಆದಾಯ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Good income is earned from brokerage in this market.

definition: the fact or an instance of different things being placed very closely, bundled or packed tightly together.
example_en: The clothes were packed tightly bundled together inside the box.

definition: a girl; a lass.
example_en: That girl used to go to school.

definition: having the nature of a problem; posing a problem or difficulty.

definition: a pellet of hail; a hailstone.
example_en: Hailstones fell along with the storm and the crop was destroyed.

definition: the tree Dalbergia sisso ( = D. sissosa, D. sissu) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmers rested in the shade of the shisham tree.

definition: a game of chance, played with stakes.
example: ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜನರು ಸೊಗುಳಿ ಆಡಿ ಹಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: People lost money playing the game of chance at the fair.

definition: at all places.
example_en: This news spread to all places.

definition: that is produced.
example_en: This sculpture is one that was created by the sculptor.

definition: to become red or redder.
example_en: His face became red with shyness.

definition: a basket for catching fish in a small stream or canal.
example_en: They were catching fish by placing a fish basket in the canal.

definition: a recess or hollow in a wall, for keeping small things; a niche.
example_en: She placed the lamp in the niche in the wall.

definition: sounded; uttered.
example_en: His uttered words were heard by everyone.

definition: the annual plant Raphanus sativus of Brassicaceae family; radish plant.
example_en: Fresh radish was found in the market.

definition: to suffer from deep aversion of disinclination.
example_en: Whenever he saw that work he suffered from deep aversion.

definition: a title 'an excellently generous man'.
example: ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ದಾನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಆತನನ್ನು ಉದಾರಮಹೇಶ್ವರ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: They called him 'Udara Maheshwara' because he gave generously to the poor.

definition: to accuse; to charge; to complain; to prosecute.
example_en: The police accused him of theft.

definition: land on either side and along a river; bank.
example_en: The boat reached the bank of the river.

definition: a path, way, road, etc.

example_en: This path goes straight to the centre of the town.

definition: absence of rain for a prolonged period over a wide area; drought.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: There was a wart on the grandfather's face.

definition: a man who won a victory; victor; a conqueror; a winner.
example_en: The victor who won the match received the prize.

definition: a becoming extinguished.
example_en: In Buddhism, nirvana is the ultimate goal.

definition: to make gestures using one's fingers.
example_en: The dancer made finger gestures in tune with the song.

definition: to destroy, ruin completely.
example_en: The enemies completely destroyed the town.

definition: a kind of bush.
example_en: This kind of bush had grown abundantly on the hillside.

definition: ended or brought to an end; concluded.
example_en: The meeting's programme was brought to an end.

definition: a woman who is unable to distinguish one or several chromatic colours.
example: ಆ ಬಣ್ಣಗುರುಡಿ ತನ್ನ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳ ಬಣ್ಣವನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಗುರುತಿಸಲಾರಳು.
example_en: That colour-blind woman cannot correctly identify the colours of her clothes.

definition: the onomatopoeic word formed imitating the whispering sound.
example_en: The children's whispering sound was heard throughout the room.

definition: a heap of sand; a dune.
example_en: When the wind blows, the sand dune slowly shifts.

definition: to become demolished, destroyed completely.
example_en: The hut was completely destroyed by the strong wind.

definition: the quality of being devotedly truthful, virtuous.
example_en: His devotion to truthfulness is an example to everyone.

definition: a wrong explanation or presentation of facts.
example_en: A wrong presentation of the incident was published in the newspaper.

definition: any of the chief meals of the day (either lunch or dinner).
example_en: Everyone gathered for the noon meal.

definition: to show compassion; to sympathise.
example_en: Showing compassion towards the poor is the duty of a human being.

definition: the most formidable, wrathful form of Mother-Goddess Pārvati, representing the destructive aspect of mother-nature.
example: ಭಕ್ತರು ದೇವಿ ಕಾಳಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಪೂಜೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The devotees offered worship before the goddess Kali.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example_en: In the village, they use the bamboo plate to dry grain.

definition: a big bundle or large bagful of burden.
example: ಕೂಲಿಯಾಳು ಬೆನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಂಡಗೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತನು.
example_en: The labourer carried a large bundle of burden on his back.

definition: that is offered in a sacrifice (to the gods); sacrificed.
example: ಆ ಪಶು ಯಜ್ಞದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಷ್ಟ ಆಗಿ ಅರ್ಪಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: That animal was offered as a sacrifice in the yajna.

definition: any of the ornaments worn.
example_en: She had worn a gold ornament on her hand.

definition: to hold back; to prevent from going.
example_en: The father held the son back from going to the village.

definition: a place, distant from the native land, where a group of people settle but remain under the political jurisdiction of their native land; a colony.
example: ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷರು ಭಾರತವನ್ನು ತಮ್ಮ ವಸಹಾತು ಆಗಿ ಆಳಿದರು.
example_en: The British ruled India as their colony.

definition: to cause to join with or together.
example_en: He joined the two pipes together.

definition: to look desolated, abandoned or deserted.
example_en: The street without people looked desolated.

definition: any of a genus (Hippocampus) of small, semitropical, marine bony fishes of the same family (Syngnathidae order Gasterosteiformes) as the pipefishes, having a slender prehensile tail, plated body, and a head and foreparts somewhat suggestive of those of a horse, and the male of which incubates the eggs in a pouch in his abdomen; a sea horse.
example: ಸಮುದ್ರದ ಆಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಲ ಕುದುರೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಮೀನುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In the depths of the sea, the sea horse catches small fish.

definition: great fatigue or weariness; exhaustion.
example_en: He became exhausted from the long journey.

definition: a religious initiation of a person into Vaiṣṇava cult.
example_en: The guru initiated him into the Vaishnava cult.
